projection.preserve: Every other serialized field, recursively and without normalization or omission, including future members.
projection.invalid_opaque_identifier: Reject a missing, non-string or blank identifier before omission.
projection.disabled_path: Existing to_json bytes and native request state remain unchanged.

exact_oracles: KV bytes equal prompt tokens times 49152
TTFT equals its five-term realized causal decomposition

handoff: At fixed prompt, adding 100000000 ps to handoff adds exactly 100000000 ps to TTFT and zero to TPOT.
prompt: At fixed handoff, doubling prompt length strictly increases prefill service and TTFT, and TPOT does not decrease.

fatal_guards: Source, config, prompt or accepted-artifact hash mismatch
The two arms did not execute in separate native processes with fresh engines
Any missing, duplicated or reordered frozen cell
Any raw result difference outside the two declared root identifier fields, or either expected fresh identifier is equal
Projection differs from a direct copy of every nonexcluded raw member
Any changed accepted pd_session_v1 compact cell
Any change to raw to_json bytes or result state caused by projection
Any nonempty lookup provenance on the record-absent arm
Any nonmonotonic timestamp, TTFT decomposition failure or physical-bound violation
Any packet backend or physical GPU work in this declared CPU skeleton slice
A corruption of any preserved leaf fails to change projected canonical bytes
void_policy: Any fatal guard, exact oracle or behavioral relation failure makes the run VOID with behavioral_score null. The original CORE-53 run is never rescored.
